checks.comparison: The source requires each local objective to be C2 on the whole Euclidean space; the clause retains both locality and global domain.
The same positive m and upper M bound every local Hessian at every point, in quadratic-form order. This does not assume the desired convergence conclusion.
The operator-norm Hessian Lipschitz inequality is global in x,y with nonnegative L, including L=0.
The base direction uses the local gradient and weighted neighbor discrepancy, scaled by eta/lambda exactly as Algorithm 2.
Algorithm 2 starts at the supplied stacked x0 with positive eta,lambda and fixed inner K; no optimizer is supplied to the method.
The recurrence uses the Hessian at the current outer iterate and neighbor direction values; K-1 applications produce ghat_(K-1), including no inner applications for K=1.
The returned next point subtracts ghat_(K-1), with the outer iterate index independent of fixed K.
The raw analytic upper curvature constant retains M+2(1-wmin)/lambda; the new tuning upper bound A is distinguished from this exact source a.
The minimum is over the diagonal entries of a nonempty finite weight matrix, so the numerical quantity is defined.
The penalty objective is sum of local objectives plus x-transpose(I-Z)x/(2 lambda), with the exact factor 1/2.
The Kronecker action equals the weighted sum on each block; off-neighbor zero weights justify restricting the sum to neighbors and self.
For symmetric W, differentiation of the penalty quadratic yields (I-Z)x/lambda; the local-gradient stacking matches the source formula.
h sums f_i evaluated at the respective local blocks, rather than evaluating all functions at a common consensus point.
The local Hessian is block diagonal and the penalty adds the constant linear map (I-Z)/lambda, with Euclidean product inner product.
The execution theorem relates k full all-agent gradient/Hessian oracle replies to x_k. The repaired application binds the arbitrary admissible oracle and specializes eta and k to the tuned values.
The oracle contract supplies every local gradient and Hessian at the queried stacked point for every call and tape value; it is deterministic information even with an arbitrary oracle seed type.
Strong convexity gives a quadratic coercive lower bound; C2 gives continuity, and finite-dimensional coercivity establishes attainment. This justifies the source reference xstar.

The defined interface preserves source objective assumptions, uses a supplied gap upper bound, excludes xstar and objectives from Public, pins tuned Algorithm2, and makes success the direct pointwise penalty-gap accuracy inequality. This definition is faithful; its missing prerequisite edges are reported separately.
Symmetry follows from equality of second derivatives for C2 local functions plus symmetry of W; the sum remains self-adjoint.
A Lipschitz Hessian gives the cubic Taylor remainder L times norm(y-x)^3/6, by two integrations along the segment.
Integrating the Hessian quadratic-form bounds along the segment gives the exact lower and upper Taylor terms with coefficient c/2.

All 17 nodes are reachable from TH2, but the new DSETUP prerequisite closure contains only DTUNE. Its stated valid/admissible/successful/allowedAlgorithm definitions require NET, DEFF, A1, A4 and ALG. Missing these requires_definition edges makes statement-construction ordering incomplete.
The required source results are P1,P1Q,LM4,LM5,TH2. The only convergence claim is TH2. DOBOC superlinear convergence and the motivating optimal-control approximation are not invoked by this proof.

Independently inspected NET: setup is justified by its mathematical content. Problem formulation of Section 2: communication network and weight matrix shared by every result; contains only conditions, no claim.
Independently inspected DEFF: definition is justified by its mathematical content. Definitions of h, Z, the penalty function F and its gradient/Hessian expressions; no claim.
Independently inspected DEFA: definition is justified by its mathematical content. Numerical definitions of w_min and a used in Proposition 1, Lemma 5 and Theorem 2; no claim.
Independently inspected ALG: algorithm is justified by its mathematical content. DOBOC-K (Algorithm 2 / its lemma) is the method analysed by Lemma 5 and Theorem 2.
Independently inspected A1: assumption is justified by its mathematical content. Assumption 1 (label A1) is a standing hypothesis of Proposition 1, Lemma 4, Lemma 5 and Theorem 2.
Independently inspected A4: assumption is justified by its mathematical content. Assumption 2 (label A4) is a hypothesis of Lemma 4, Lemma 5 and Theorem 2.

Independently inspected DTAY: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. Standard calculus facts (Taylor bounds) used by the source in (mu), (L) and in Lemma 4 ('Taylor expansion error'); derived, not a convergence claim.

Independently inspected DSYM: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. Symmetry of Hessians of C^2 functions, needed to treat grad^2 F(x) as a symmetric matrix with real eigenvalues (Proposition 1, proof of Lemma 5); derived.
Independently inspected P1: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. This is a Hessian bound, not a convergence claim.
Independently inspected P1Q: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. These are quadratic estimates, not convergence claims.

Independently inspected DMIN: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. Existence of the minimum point x_* that the source presupposes ('Let x_* be the minimum point of F'); derived from the strong convexity bound (mu).
Independently inspected LM4: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. This is a Taylor estimate, not convergence.
Independently inspected LM5: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. This is a one-step supporting bound used in the geometric induction.

Independently inspected DEXEC: supporting_proposition is justified by its mathematical content. Correspondence between the template execution and the DOBOC-K iterates (one oracle call per iteration); derived cost/execution witness, not a convergence claim.

Independently inspected TH2: convergence_result is justified by its mathematical content. This is the only recursively required standalone convergence result; its raw theorem and public wrapper represent one source owner.
Independently inspected DTUNE: definition is justified by its mathematical content. These are numerical definitions, not theorem claims or a second convergence export.
